Welcome to Animal Therapy Center 

We specialize in helping pets move, heal, and thrive through a wide range of therapeutic modalities, including physical rehabilitation, hydrotherapy, laser and electrotherapy, massage, and wellness consultations. Our dedicated team works closely with pet owners and our veterinarian to create personalized treatment plans that improve mobility, reduce pain, and enhance quality of life.

Subscribe to learn more about our therapies, success stories, and helpful tips for supporting your pet’s recovery and well-being.

Located in the Lehigh Valley
information@animaltherapycenter.com
